method.latency: Median of uninstrumented process medians; one discarded warmup per process.
method.comparisons: Candidate/reference ratios pair process medians from the same round and workload. Negative percentage changes mean less time, fewer requests/bytes, or less process RSS. Speedup is reference/candidate; above 1 means faster.
method.parent: The immediately preceding draft in drafts.json; all drafts form a cumulative stack.
method.ranges: Minimum and maximum observed same-round ratios; these are not confidence intervals or significance tests.
method.allocations: Median of instrumented process medians. Counts include alloc, alloc_zeroed and realloc requests; bytes sum requested allocation sizes, not live or peak heap usage.
method.rss: Median whole-process peak RSS across timing processes, including output verification and checked-graph JSON serialization. Instrumented-process RSS is retained separately; neither measures frontend-only peak or retained heap memory.
